summary: DRY scan of the 910 diff found no mechanical duplication in production code. The one test-helper duplication (tests/common fund_usdt_wallet vs the 910 file's seed_wallet) is not a drop-in: seed_wallet takes any cryptocurrency and balance and the 910 tests use BTC and several USDT amounts, while the common helper seeds a fixed 10_000_000_000 USDT. Left as is. No file changed in DRY, so cargo was not rerun; the tree is the one the TEMPER gate passed. The gate is green except the environment-bound 864 test.
requirements: AC1: An offer that uses an escrow mode the platform does not support is refused when it is created, with a clear error to the caller.
AC2: No trade can open without the seller's USDT being locked in the same step, so no customer sees an open trade that is not funded.
AC3: A trade cannot be marked funded by hand, so funded always means the seller's USDT is locked.
AC4: Custodial offers, resells and crypto swaps are created and funded exactly as they are today.
